prompt:
SUMMARY: a long braided side sweep gathered into a single low loop behind the neck; dragon-scale armor covering the body with horn-shaped shoulder and head ornaments — a beastly, imposing silhouette; The front armor is divided into opposing banks of dragon scales that change their direction at a single hinged breastplate seam. diamond-shaped face with softly defined cheekbones and a tapered chin, phoenix eyes with gracefully lifted outer corners, of natural size, gracefully arched brows; a relaxed closed-mouth half-smile.
A full-body character image, vertical 2:3 (1024×1536): Han Sui of the Romance of the Three Kingdoms, reimagined as an adult woman — the sworn sibling of Ma Teng who became her enemy.

1. STYLE
Korean MMORPG character artwork. A recognisably drawn face with gently simplified anatomical structure. 2D painting with visible brushwork: layered strokes of colour, soft broken edges, thin coloured linework and a few crisp accents on the face and costume.
Her face is small and soft: a short midface, a softly rounded jaw and a small chin, about 1.3 times as long as it is wide, with her eyes open at their natural size. Bangs, side locks and headpieces frame the face without lengthening it.
Skin finish: dewy, glass-like highlights on the skin of her shoulders, arms, collarbones and legs — a soft, luminous wet-look sheen that follows the body's forms; her face keeps a soft, natural finish.

2. CHARACTER
Age: mid-twenties — a clear adult face.
Face — her own, recognisably this character, a woman's face with no beard or facial hair: a regal, imperious haughtiness; porcelain-pale skin; diamond-shaped face with softly defined cheekbones and a tapered chin; phoenix eyes with gracefully lifted outer corners, of natural size; honey-gold eyes; gracefully arched brows; slim, delicate nose with a refined bridge; thin lips with a defined cupid's bow.
Body and hair: hourglass-figured — full bust and hips, distinctly narrow-waisted build; a long braided side sweep gathered into a single low loop behind the neck; polished copper-red hair.
Expression: a slight smile, lips closed, subtle and relaxed.
Legend, carried in her design and bearing: crafty frontier politics, weathered armor, a two-faced smile.
Anatomy: one head, two arms and two legs, each joined at its natural joint; natural hands with five fingers.

3. COSTUME AND EQUIPMENT — MEDIEVAL FANTASY
Costume: a knight-champion's armor — articulated plate with a heraldic tabard in her faction's colours, a plumed helm or circlet, a battle cape, her weapon at hand. Western medieval high-fantasy dress — plate, mail and heraldic tabards, gowns and mantles, circlets and crowns; steel, leather, wool, velvet and gold, with a subtle magical glow along the patterns. Her Three Kingdoms origin shows through her signature item, her colours and her bearing.
Silhouette: dragon-scale armor covering the body with horn-shaped shoulder and head ornaments — a beastly, imposing silhouette. This silhouette sets the overall shape of the costume above — keep its materials, ornaments and rank in this shape; the details are free.
Design idea: The front armor is divided into opposing banks of dragon scales that change their direction at a single hinged breastplate seam.
Colours: desert sand, rust orange, dark leather brown and steel.
Signature item: a curved frontier saber, reimagined as a Western high-fantasy version of the same kind of object with the same silhouette — polished steel and silvered mithril throughout, the shaft or hilt also forged metal with engraved runes (never plain wood), a faint magical glow running along the edge and the runes, a gem-set guard or socket, a leather-wrapped grip and heraldic or elven ornament, with any animal motif re-sculpted in Western heraldic style. She holds it at full scale: one whole object, drawn once, held in front of or beside her body; a long weapon keeps one straight, unbroken shaft with a single head or blade.
Exposure (bold): her regalia opens to show skin — bare upper arms below the pauldrons, which stay seated on top of her shoulders (bare shoulders only where no shoulder guard sits), a deep open neckline under the gorget with natural cleavage, the tabard or gown cut with a high side slit at full length — it shows the side line of one leg as she stands, no leg pushed out or knee bent for it; armor pieces stay on and symmetrical. Intimate areas covered; no corset; keep the costume material and palette.

4. SCENE
World: the shattered realms of medieval high fantasy, an age of rival warlords after a fallen empire: a ruined imperial capital, mercenary camps, border keeps, outlaw marches and wild southern jungles, dark violet battle-magic.
Pose: standing confidently, her body turned slightly while her face looks toward the viewer.
Stance and hands: She holds the curved saber at her side with one hand, and the other hand rests open and visible.
Setting detail: In a sandstone border keep with sharp arch shadows and dust shining above the flagstones.
Light: a soft key light with a strong rim light tracing her hair, shoulders and armour; bright, crisp specular highlights on metal and jewellery, and a clean, warm-neutral sheen on her skin.
Composition: her whole figure from the top of her head or headpiece to both feet inside the frame with clear margins, about four-fifths of the image height; camera at chest height with natural portrait perspective.

5. CONSTRAINTS
One figure only — no second character, horse or other creature. No readable text or numbers — banners and shields carry only heraldic devices (a beast or a crest), never letters or Chinese characters. No logo, watermark, speech bubble or frame border. A Western medieval setting and dress only — stone castles, Romanesque or Gothic architecture — with no Chinese architecture, robes or hanzi.
Avoid: a blue or bruise-like tint on the skin around the eyes, glossy or shiny highlights on the face, sweaty, oily or plastic-looking skin.
